options.title: Nike Paid {fact1} for the Swoosh
options.first_line: Nike paid {fact1} for the Swoosh on your shoes.
options.first_frame: A black Nike sneaker on a white floor, pushing in on its Swoosh, as the price counts up beside it.

options.title: The Swoosh on Your Shoes Cost Nike {fact1}
options.first_line: The Swoosh on your shoes cost Nike {fact1}.
options.first_frame: Close on the Swoosh of a black Nike sneaker, a 'The Swoosh' label wiping in and the price slamming in over it.

options.title: A Student Drew Nike's Swoosh for {fact1}
options.first_line: A design student drew Nike's Swoosh, and got {fact1} for it.
options.first_frame: A Portland State University sign among autumn leaves, then a hard cut to the Swoosh on a sneaker with the price over it.

why: All three show the price up front, but only C leaves a question open (who was the student, and was that really all she got?), which gives a stranger a reason to stay, and it still lands on the Swoosh on a sneaker.
